name: testfly-appium-inspector
description: Start and stop an Appium 3 server, list Android and iOS devices, and inspect native app screens with ready-to-paste Appium java-client locators.

testflyAppiumInspector.appium.path.description: Appium executable used to start the server (Appium 3.x).

testflyAppiumInspector.appium.host.description: Address the started Appium server listens on.

testflyAppiumInspector.appium.basePath.description: Base path of the Appium server (--base-path), for example /wd/hub.

testflyAppiumInspector.appium.autoStart.description: Start the Appium server when the TestFly Appium view opens and no server answers.

testflyAppiumInspector.adbPath.description: adb executable. Empty: adb from ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT or PATH.

testflyAppiumInspector.ios.xcodeOrgId.description: Team ID that signs WebDriverAgent on a real iOS device (appium:xcodeOrgId).

testflyAppiumInspector.ios.xcodeSigningI.description: Signing identity for WebDriverAgent on a real iOS device (appium:xcodeSigningId).

testflyAppiumInspector.ios.updatedWDABun.description: Your own WebDriverAgent bundle id, needed with a free Apple ID (appium:updatedWDABundleId).

testflyAppiumInspector.autoRefreshAfterA.description: Read the screen again after a tap, swipe, text, back or home action.

enumDescriptions: Appium java-client 9.x or 10.x (Selenium 4.x): PageFactory from org.openqa.selenium.support
testflyAppiumInspector.codegen.javaClien.description: java-client version the generated Java code compiles against.

enumDescriptions: private static final By constants (AppiumBy / By.xpath)
testflyAppiumInspector.codegen.style.description: Style of the generated Java locators.

testflyAppiumInspector.ios.preferDevicec.markdownDescription: Start Appium with `APPIUM_XCUITEST_PREFER_DEVICECTL=1`: XCUITest then finds real iOS devices with devicectl, also one that is not reachable over USB (Wi-Fi). **Simulator sessions fail on that server** (XCUITest takes the simulators devicectl lists for real devices), so turn it on only for a real device that Appium reports as an unknown UDID. Takes effect when the extension starts the server.
